citations.quote: This policy provides liability coverage only. It does not include Collision or Other Than Collision (comprehensive) coverage. We will not pay for loss to your covered auto from any cause, including collision, theft, fire, vandalism, weather, or glass breakage.

output.reasoning: The policy explicitly states that it is a liability-only policy and excludes coverage for physical damage to the insured's own vehicle (collision). The claim for a damaged rear bumper falls under the exclusion of 'loss to your covered auto' as defined in clause LIAB-2.
